name: Incident Management & Postmortems
description: Incident Management & Postmortems standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-INCIDENT applies.

rules.title: Define severity levels and escalation ownership
rules.detail: Incidents are classified by user/business impact with clear on-call/incident commander escalation paths.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define severity levels and escalation ownership.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define severity levels and escalation ownership.

rules.title: Prioritize mitigation before root-cause perfection
rules.detail: During active impact, stabilize service, protect data and communicate status before deep remediation when safe.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prioritize mitigation before root-cause perfection.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prioritize mitigation before root-cause perfection.

rules.title: Maintain a timestamped incident timeline
rules.detail: Record detections, decisions, actions, deployments and communications to support coordination and later analysis.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Maintain a timestamped incident timeline.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Maintain a timestamped incident timeline.

rules.title: Communicate using known channels and cadence
rules.detail: Stakeholders receive impact, mitigation and next-update expectations without exposing unverified or sensitive detail.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Communicate using known channels and cadence.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Communicate using known channels and cadence.

rules.title: Run blameless postmortems for material incidents
rules.detail: Capture contributing technical/process factors, detection gaps and prioritized corrective actions with owners/dates.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Run blameless postmortems for material incidents.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Run blameless postmortems for material incidents.

rules.title: Track corrective actions to completion
rules.detail: High-risk recurrence prevention items become normal governed work and are not closed merely when service is restored.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Track corrective actions to completion.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Track corrective actions to completion.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-INCIDENT applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Incident Management & Postmortems to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Incident Management & Postmortems is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Incident Management & Postmortems failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
